name: @central360/broadcast-client
description: Official Central360 satellite SDK — drop-in TypeScript client for the Parinas Central360 HUB broadcast feature. Server-side proxy (HubBroadcastClient + Express router factory) + React layer (BroadcastProvider, hooks, drop-in components: BellIconWithBadge, InboxPanel, BroadcastBanner, BroadcastModalQueue). See the broadcast spec Part III §7 for the full integration guide.
author: Parinas Group Companies (PGC) — Central360 HUB team
